reapack.name: StudioSync.lua
reapack.desc: StudioSync: record together remotely over a shared folder

version.author: James
version.changelog: StudioSync: the full rename. The ReaPack package, scripts, actions, repository and installers now carry the new name. If you installed it as BandSync, remove the BandSync repository in ReaPack and add this one.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A new install's ReaPack repository is called StudioSync, and the old name is switched off where it's found.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The nightly backup keeps its folders.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Deleting a copy can't freeze REAPER any more: it goes to the Recycle Bin in the background, with no hidden error box.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Clashes: the owner's change wins, and a Use mine button takes yours back straight from the message. New: colour the whole project, tracks by gradient, folder, instrument, person, newest work and more, and regions by section or along the song.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The classic panel is gone. New mirror tracks say (studio), old (band) ones still count. Several suggestions fold to one line with Review; each says what and how long ago; a grouped fader's suggestion says a folder or VCA goes straight through. Settings Health lists what needs you first, in columns when wide. Restore's filters fold when space is short. Studio cards sit side by side in a wide panel; project rows don't stretch. Driving isn't yellow. A panel failure now names itself in the console.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Track order is the same on every computer: whoever moves a track publishes the list, and each computer comes onto the newest one. A big restore runs in slices so REAPER keeps going, with one undo point. On a Mac, projects reopen at start with no load boxes, using REAPER's own -ignoreerrors (proven on Windows, needs a Mac test).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Produce: a button beside Follow and Listen. Hear someone record on your own grid as it happens, your song a moment behind theirs from your own copy, with Talk between takes; what's being sung over goes quiet here. By default over SonoBus with a position stamp and no server (new effects StudioSync stamp send and read); a NINJAM server is the other route. Colours: items by section, along the song, by person, lane or takes, and a live What's new view that fades over the hour.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tailscale is back in the installers, not optional: the NINJAM route reaches its server over it. The server's address is saved as this computer's Tailscale name, which doesn't change. Health says if Tailscale isn't installed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From the first Produce test over real SonoBus: SonoBus joins by itself sooner, a false 'no sound's arriving' warning is gone, the producer's side now hears that someone's recording, and whichever computer has the NINJAM server's folder runs it (in mirrored rooms there's no host).

version.author: James
version.changelog: More from the real Produce test: the stamp reader no longer loses its place when your transport starts, a steady tone can't pass for a stamp at the top of the song, and the NINJAM route cleans up after itself.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Produce button is on the people cards too, not only the docked list. Stopping the NINJAM route closes ReaNINJAM's window.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Produce through a NINJAM server now tested end to end: a play-through no longer leaves placeholders that play twice on the next pass, and the panel says this route has no talkback.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Docked at the bottom, the panel now looks right both tall and at the mixer's smallest height. Reopening a project no longer sends SWS's recolouring as your edit. Produce through a NINJAM server connects by itself, at the right level, and survives the server going away instead of crashing REAPER. Colouring items counts tracks you made. No more version box on every open.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A backup or autosave of a shared song now asks: open it as a side room you can merge from, or just look. Superior Drummer no longer re-sends the Drums after every playthrough. After a restart, tabs behind the front one sync again. Big projects hitch far less. NINJAM connects by itself on the Play tab and on a Mac, and reconnects if the server drops. Health says whether Tailscale is on.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM keeps trying for a few minutes when it can't reach the server, and says to press OK if ReaNINJAM shows a box: on a Mac nothing connects until that's pressed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: On a Mac, NINJAM connects once when the server answers, instead of retrying over a connection it can't see.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A shorter line when ReaNINJAM needs its box answered on a Mac.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A real backup file (.rpp-bak) now gets the backup bar; REAPER's offline-when-inactive setting is turned off once; old BandSync actions are removed; the nightly backup skips test songs.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Just look no longer carries over to a new tab of a backup.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The top bar says when the driver's away.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The NINJAM server now ships with StudioSync for Windows and Mac: the first computer to connect runs it, and the next takes over if it's gone. Host it here moves it by hand.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Changing Produce's route takes effect straight away; Bring into main no longer lists deletes of what main already lost.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Whoever's being produced follows the NINJAM server if it moves, and never starts one from an old address.

version.author: James
version.changelog: ReaNINJAM runs out of sight, with its status in the panel (Show it brings its window up). Health says whether Tailscale stays signed in. Produce takes the NINJAM server over if it goes, and everyone follows it if it moves.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A fresh NINJAM connect on a Mac no longer waits on a closed window; the connection box closes as soon as it opens; the route button stays put.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Health and the log say if Windows hasn't let the NINJAM server accept connections.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM connects straight away at the start of Produce; the route button stays under the pointer.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Every Produce connects straight away, not only the first.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM's status line uses the computer's short name.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Windows installer asks up front to let the NINJAM server accept connections, for Tailscale addresses only.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From a code review: a backup can't start syncing from Set up everything; a live NINJAM host isn't taken over by mistake; Stop server on the Play page; dead code removed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: From a design review: less header on a small panel, a one-line put-back bar when it fits, full plug-in names, and a Copy button for the Tailscale line.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Stop server shows the server stopped straight away.

version.author: James
version.changelog: NINJAM keeps watching after it gives up, and connects once the server answers: a firewall box waiting for Allow no longer leaves everyone unconnected.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Stop server asks everyone on it to disconnect first, so no ReaNINJAM box appears (on a Mac one held StudioSync until OK). Copy buttons use SWS's clipboard where it's there.

version.author: James
version.changelog: After Stop server nobody presses Connect at a server that's going, and a server counts as answering only on two checks in a row.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Background checks hand back their newest answer: a stopped NINJAM server no longer reads as answering. A restarted server clears its stopping mark.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Window and Dock on the panel's title bar, always there; Draw and Show drawings on Chat's tab bar; smoother scrolling; less gap under the bar; a sharper big logo; a button to Tailscale's machines page in Health.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Invite a guest for a day: with a Tailscale access token (Settings > Advanced), an invitation also puts the guest's computer on your Tailscale network for a day, no account needed; old guests are taken off. Set up the tags: one click adds StudioSync's tagOwners lines to the Tailscale policy. The logo's flames and link are smooth at large sizes.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Guests for a day, tested on the real network: the Studios page gets a Guest button; someone who already has StudioSync and pastes a guest invitation is asked, then signed in to the inviter's Tailscale network for the day. A studio's buttons wrap on a narrow panel, and the title hides where it ran under Window and Dock.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Set up the tags can now limit guests: on Tailscale's starting policy it asks, then lets guests reach only StudioSync's file sharing and jams on your computers. Policies with their own rules are left alone.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Big songs no longer stall REAPER for 1.6 s every 10 s while Google Drive's copy catches up: Drive copies in short slices, never in the same pass as a look. The look nothing asked for comes less often on big songs. Live sync notes what slowed any tick over 0.15 s. Bin moves can't share a temp script.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: ReaNINJAM connects through a small local relay, so a NINJAM server that goes away no longer leaves its 'Disconnected from host!' alert holding every script: StudioSync disconnects cleanly and connects again when the server's back.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: the NINJAM relay no longer brings up ReaNINJAM's 'can't connect' alert when Connect is pressed while the server's down: it holds the connection quietly for up to 100 s and connects when the server's back. A reconnect left under an alert can't loop. Windows installer: a guest's Tailscale sign-in happens before the REAPER step, so a REAPER hiccup can't leave the invitation's key unused.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Windows installer: REAPER now gets its setup step. It was started as -nonewinst glued to the script's path, so a fresh REAPER showed its Usage box and StudioSync's scripts never arrived (found installing into a clean Windows Sandbox).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Windows installer: says to answer REAPER's first-start audio question and ReaPack's Manage repositories (the setup waits on them), and that Tailscale's welcome window may cover them. Checked end to end in a clean Windows Sandbox: with those answered, StudioSync installs and registers its actions.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: Connect works again after a Leave in the same REAPER session (ReaNINJAM keeps its one window, which StudioSync had noted as closed and skipped), and StudioSync opens at most one NINJAM connection box at a time (up to four were stacked, the top one taking every click).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: reconnecting after the NINJAM server goes away no longer brings up ReaNINJAM's 'can't connect' alert. The relay holds a new connection only 5 s (ReaNINJAM gives up after about 10), checks the server itself while idle, and StudioSync reconnects on that check, uncapped. README: Cancel the connection box before OK on the alert.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: reconnecting after a long NINJAM server outage presses the connection box that's on screen, not a closed copy macOS still lists, and gives each try a moment before trying again.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Mac: no more connect/disconnect churn when NINJAM connection boxes pile up: once ReaNINJAM is connected or connecting, extra boxes are cancelled instead of pressed (16 connects in 15 s had ended in 'Error creating session directory!'). If a box won't take StudioSync's press for 20 s (another REAPER window in front, like ReaPack's report), the log says so.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Clashes: two changes to one item made apart are merged line by line; where both rewrote the notes or audio, the loser's version is kept as another take on its own lane. Quick nudges within 30 s count as one edit, and ties go to a clock that a wrong computer clock can't win. Producer mode: a performer can let the producer start, record and stop their transport. The Mac relay now quits when REAPER does.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Docked, the panel's top bar folds into a thin strip coloured by sync status (and Settings, when it wants a look); move the mouse to the top to open it. It stays open when it has something to press. Producer mode: each transport button has its own tip, and Record says when nothing is armed on the performer's side.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Producer mode: letting a producer start and stop your transport now names that producer (it isn't handed to whoever produces you next; tick it again after updating). Their press reaches you as it lands, whatever their clock says, and their own song now starts and stops with yours. Docked panel: the page waits a moment after the top bar opens or folds, so a click can't land on what moved, and a dropdown on the page no longer opens the bar.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Producer mode: a Record press for someone with nothing armed no longer brings up REAPER's Record Warning on their computer (it held StudioSync until answered); they're told to arm a track instead. The log no longer says recording started when REAPER didn't start.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Review fixes and new features. Safer: a bandmate's plug-in files can only go where plug-in files belong; deletes on a drive with no Recycle Bin are left alone; your edit can't be overwritten before StudioSync has seen it; old versions are kept in Syncthing. Merges: two quick edits arriving out of order are no longer taken for a clash; merges start from the real shared version. New: Export stems, Compare two mixes (A/B), Credits draft, a Stage for each project, Since you were last here, notes you can tick off as resolved, a new mix announced in chat, a SonoBus singer's own file swapped in and lined up. Simpler: plain 'Not sent' messages with a Claim button, a Show advanced controls switch, Leave always visible, new projects start with Anyone editing. The docked strip is gone.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Settings > Health and Updates now live in their own file (no change you'll see), and the 'Your studios' button on Settings > You works again.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Restore page now lives in its own file (no change you'll see).

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Rooms page now lives in its own file (no change you'll see).

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Play/Jam page now lives in its own file (no change you'll see). That finishes splitting the panel: Health, Restore, Rooms and Play/Jam each have their own file now.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Security: the live audio's password is the studio's own and changes when someone is taken out; a guest let in For a day stops syncing a day later; a new version arriving in a shared-folder install asks first; StudioSync's temp files are tidied when REAPER quits. Fixes: a REAPER box held open no longer makes Live sync save an end-of-session version and restart; stems skip silent tracks; a singer's own file lines up whatever the item's length; start and stop cues reach the others about a second sooner. New: dry stems; Health shows files two computers changed at once; Save this version can keep it for good (Back up is gone); plainer status words; one Invite button; Can't hear? under Real time; the Prepare checklist starts as a short summary.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Someone back after more than a month: their item changes are settled whole the same way on every computer, never merged against a version trim may have removed. New tests for the guard that holds the band's changes until yours are seen.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Review fixes: projects can no longer drift apart from a trimmed base or a wrong clock; a bandmate's change can't copy your private files or place plug-in files in config folders; damaged or renamed change files are handled; installer fixes (Mac startup marker, safe downloads, startup file kept). Faster: already-handled files are skipped, old entries leave the project file, saved after every catch-up. New: Live set mode pauses syncing while playing; drop audio into a song's inbox folder to add it as a stem.

version.author: James
version.changelog: New: phone alerts through the ntfy app, studio templates (Save as studio template, New from template), a Call button for the studio's own call link, and Talk (talkback that never records and goes quiet while recording). Reopening a long song no longer reads every change file. Review fixes: claims files speak only for their owner, released claims can't overwrite each other, removal frees claims before it's marked done, background scripts delete themselves, the Recycle Bin move no longer freezes REAPER, a deletion with missing history isn't silently kept on one computer, and automatic saves are logged.

version.author: James
version.changelog: New: the listening page (Settings: Share the listening page) serves every song's mixes to phones and browsers on your Tailscale network, with comments that land in the song's chat. Private live audio (Settings: Host it on this computer) has everyone's SonoBus meet through a band member's computer over Tailscale, so the audio travels encrypted.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Settings has a new Studio tab for phone alerts (with a test button), the studio call, the listening page and private live audio, each explained in a line. Studios on different Tailscale accounts: each studio remembers its network, and Health offers a Switch button when this computer is on another one. The listening page names mixes more simply. Tested on a real phone and in Chrome.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tailscale account switches are written down (from, to, until), Health keeps a Switch back button until you return, and a computer others rely on can put itself back. A switch now reads the accounts fresh and StudioSync sees the new network within seconds. Tested with real switches on the PC.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The installers offer ReaPersona for anyone coming from another DAW: REAPER's shortcuts, mouse and look made to work like the DAW you know.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The installers' extras now include a drum kit everyone has (MuldjordKit, played in sforzando on Windows and Mac), and remind you to get Decent Sampler.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Fix: on a fresh Windows where winget makes no shortcut, the installer and StudioSync now find Syncthing where winget unpacked it (it said installed, then stopped).

version.author: James
version.changelog: New: Update REAPER (Settings > Updates) opens the REAPER Update Utility, or ReaPack on it if it isn't installed yet. The installer tells you to allow Syncthing through Windows Firewall. Tested end to end on a clean Windows VM.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Beginner fixes: invitation with newcomer steps first, a Show invitation box with Copy again, a Getting started checklist, a joined studio shows as waiting with its connection status, installers ask start or join with no default, no folder question, plainer plug-in questions (extras only when starting), REAPER's first-start questions explained up front, no sign-in waits for joiners. New Mixes tab (render, stems, A/B, credits, templates, copy outside, listening page). Real time mode first on Home; Exit and Disconnect instead of three Leaves; Driver + claimed tracks; Parts play Auto / Through my plug-ins / As printed; Stand-ins; clearer empty states. Bindable actions: Hold my changes, Claim selected tracks, Local mixing, Keep selected tracks local. Read automation mode syncs. Fixes: Mac installer on macOS 11, Gatekeeper wording, Tailscale extension wait; listening page server per connection; alerts never cut a character in half; one talk track; inbox and trash fixes.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The installer asks for your invitation instead of start or join: paste it (or run its line) and you join; press Enter and you start a studio. ReaPersona: pick the app you're used to from a list and REAPER is set up as it in the same run (look, mouse, and shortcuts, with one automatic restart when Python is installed). New API for your own scripts and controllers: who drives, who's here, claims, Hold and Local mixing, an event feed, and requests (take control, hold, claim, keep local, local mix, chat): docs/API.md.

version.author: James
version.changelog: No invitation? You don't have to start a studio: press Enter and everything installs, and StudioSync's panel offers Start a studio and Paste join code whenever you're ready (type s to start one right away).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Installer fixes from a clean-machine test: an already-open REAPER that misses the setup step is handed it again (it waited 6 minutes and gave up); clearer firewall and multi-line paste wording; one note for joiners instead of two.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Notes on a stretch: select a take and a time selection, and the note covers those bars, shaded across them on REAPER 7.86 (a point at its start on older REAPER). A note on a take played at another speed now lands in the right place. Tested on REAPER 7.86.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Fixes before the first band test: a joined studio keeps showing Waiting to be let in; REAPER no longer asks to save or delete each take; Health says when Syncthing goes through a slow relay; on a Mac, REAPER comes back after ReaPersona's shortcut install; listening pages shared before 0.58.63 work again after a restart, and never serve linked files; Guest, for a day is named as such; plus smaller fixes from four reviews.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Who runs a studio is checked: roles, removals and closing count only from the owner's or an admin's computer, as Syncthing records it. Joiners no longer accept every folder the inviter offers. The Tailscale token is locked to your account (Windows) or kept in the Keychain (Mac). Removing someone gives phone alerts a new channel. From the laptop and Mac tests: running an invitation again keeps your folder; a Mac quitting with studio tabs open brings them back; setup waits for ReaPersona; the installer re-run asks less and no longer prints your Google account; Home shows versions only for people online; an old Mac jam relay is stopped. Leftover BandSync names are StudioSync now.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Opening a song no longer takes all its changes in again: REAPER hands back its saved names in capitals, so StudioSync forgot what it had applied (534 changes at every open on the Mac) and who had been driving. A Syncthing folder still called bandsync is renamed StudioSync with the studio's name.

version.author: James
version.changelog: StudioSync is in REAPER's menus: Extensions > StudioSync and View > StudioSync open the panel (a small extension ReaPack installs with it; 64-bit Windows now, the Mac build follows; after REAPER's next start). REAPER's Actions list keeps only what opens StudioSync, plus Undo, Redo, Live sync and Draw: Settings > Advanced > Every StudioSync action in REAPER's Actions list brings back the rest, and one a key or toolbar uses always stays.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The Extensions/View menu items now for macOS and Linux too (StudioSync menus 1.0.1). They appear after REAPER's next start.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Update REAPER installs FeedTheCat's REAPER Update Utility by itself and opens it (no ReaPack window to puzzle over), and Health offers it whenever your REAPER is older than a bandmate's or than 7.86. Who controls: 'Driver + claims' again (claims cover regions and time too), and its picker is as wide as its longest choice, so nothing is cut off on a Mac.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Linux, first release: StudioSync tells Linux from a Mac (links, the Trash, port checks, REAPER's start), a Linux installer (curl line in every invitation), and the NINJAM server and relay for Linux x86_64 and ARM. Being tested on Ubuntu now.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tested on Ubuntu 24.04: install, join, open, record, edits both ways, NINJAM server and relay, the listening page, the Linux Trash, reopening, menus, Ctrl+Z. Fixed from it: the relay's status word (blank on Linux; the Mac build rebuilt too), the Linux installer's Syncthing ID with older Syncthing, a quit held up by a dialog losing the tabs to reopen, opening a song into an empty changed tab asking to save first, and 'connected to 127' for a numeric server.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Windows installer starts and joins studios again; removals count on every Syncthing; your recording on an unclaimed track goes out; no tempo-map replay on catch-up; FX containers checked; plug-in files stay private; Linux NINJAM checks without netcat

version.author: James
version.changelog: Linux stress test fixes: the installer no longer opens the panel under ReaPack's Transaction report, and the panel draws nothing while frames stand still (a 7.4 GB crash); a knob turned with no plug-in window open in the minute after a chain lands is sent; subprojects are held back instead of crashing a fresh REAPER; Syncthing's API key no longer sits in a readable /tmp script on Linux; short base64 lines in plug-in data compare as bytes; a song reopened in the same tab is caught up again; wording.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Plug-ins with an LFO sync (and a fast LFO's chain goes out at all); a knob turned while StudioSync was off goes out at the next open; anyone can unfreeze a frozen track; silent prints of notes are caught; AU parts get prints for Windows and Linux; offline-by-choice plug-ins no longer block prints. Installers: GitHub's rate limit, existing Syncthing elsewhere, portable REAPER, no winget, Flatpak/AppImage, the long first plug-in scan, non-English names. Security: the studio id and inviter are pinned, devices files and given claims are checked, the listening page is served from a private copy, invitations use the release tag, guests warn about an open tailnet. Linux: background prints, no second REAPER from the installer.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Home claims the tracks you made for you (no more 'You made these' line). Chat: Notes and Likes are their own tabs; Draw and Hide drawings are buttons above the tabs. Track colours: studio colours with 'Show who's working' and 'Show what's new' (both on by default): a bandmate's change shows briefly, and what came while you were away stays until you say OK. The studio's cloud copy can be Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, iCloud Drive or Box. Discord and other call apps: Health says when they may clash with REAPER, and Settings > Advanced > Calls has the ways round it. New Feedback button: bug report, feedback or feature request, saved in the studio's folder and/or opened as a GitHub issue.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Studios can sync only through their own Tailscale network (Settings > Studio > Sync through Tailscale): each computer tells the others its name on the studio's network, and Syncthing reaches it only there. With a studio on each of your Tailscale accounts, switching accounts switches which studio syncs.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Sharing a project with empty take lanes works (it stopped with a band.lua error). Everyone records 24-bit FLAC at the project's sample rate, kept that way, and Health says when your interface runs at another rate. The sync status is a button of its own: red and pulsing when sync is off, and clicking it starts sync. 'Control your own mix' is back. Chat has an All tab: everything, with filters and Go for what's on the timeline. Settings: a StudioSync button on REAPER's main toolbar (after a restart). Changing your name changes it in every studio.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Who can edit: Claims (default), Driver + claims (driver over claims), Driver only, Everyone, Admins only; owner/admin picks it. No auto-claims. Fixed: 'James' read 'James-Laptop' changes as its own (false 'changed at the same time'). Guests until a day you pick, with End now and Longer. Follow takes on their mix. Mute/Solo in Real time mode. Health spots Voicemeeter echo loops. Your colour in every studio. Toolbar button on by default. Faster project loading, then peaks. Smaller count on the minimized box.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Toolbar button: the StudioSync logo in a frame that matches REAPER's toolbar, added to your main toolbar even when it's customized (menu extension 1.0.3, REAPER 7.11 or newer).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Toolbar button lights up while the panel is open, however you opened it (menu extension 1.0.4).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Take comps now work across the studio: which take each piece plays travels to everyone, and takes turning into lanes keep the comp exactly (no wrong takes or silences). Prepare keeps pieces that play an empty take on purpose. Prints rendered in front no longer flash parts selected. 'SonoBus Guest'. Voicemeeter Health row removed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A log file on disk as StudioSync works (Settings > Console > Log files), with errors and where they happened. The background print renderer tries harder, shows when it's given up, and Health can tell it to try again.

version.author: James
version.changelog: After a four-reviewer pass: take comps safer (lanes, prints, Prepare), empty takes sync, edits after a marker change no longer lost, same song name in two studios kept apart, studio settings only from owners and admins, safer guest invitations. Panel goes behind REAPER (or shrinks) when you click it; the action is just 'StudioSync'. SonoBus: uncompressed audio option and Invite a SonoBus guest.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Fix: the panel couldn't open in 0.58.87 on this ReaImGui. When you click REAPER, the panel shrinks to the tiny box by default (or stays in front).

version.author: James
version.changelog: Guests can be given only some projects (the others stay hidden on their computer); automation items on sends, plug-in envelopes and loops travel whole; plug-in data inside containers and preset loads by scripts count; project defaults travel; updates wait for every file; crash-safe settings; Health warns about clocks and track group clashes.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The master's FX button is shared (kept on where SonoBus or NINJAM runs on the master).

version.author: James
version.changelog: A patch or IR loaded inside a modulated plug-in now goes out when its window closes. Markers and regions keep their numbers. A refused edit leaves your version on a (yours, not sent) track, and local item groups survive updates. Someone else's together start no longer cuts your own recording. Ctrl+Z on takes-became-lanes sticks. Faster catching up, a lighter Since you were last here, history archive fixes, and a clear message when ReaImGui is too old.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Second full review: Tailscale no longer lets guests or removed people in by itself, guest project lists stay hidden while Syncthing is slow, you stay in the band list during long takes, together stops and redo takes behave, tempo maps can't split, FX held for a print come back, restoring to the oldest version can't empty the project, Prepare backs up unsaved projects, old prints are archived with old history, Syncthing hangs no longer freeze REAPER, plus many smaller fixes.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Second look at 0.58.92: tempo maps ordered safely even when computers' clocks disagree, the Syncthing back-off now works on Windows and never holds back a change, guest project lists can't be shrunk by mistake or hide everything, the heartbeat covers Live set playback, Prepare's backups no longer overwrite each other within a minute, plus tests for everything 0.58.92 fixed.

version.author: James
version.changelog: A Tailscale access token per network: a studio on each of two Tailscale accounts keeps its own token (Settings > Advanced lists them; an older token still works), guests are swept on each, and Settings > Studio can set the studio's network to the one this computer is on.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Tempo maps are ordered properly across computers (0.58.93's fix never applied); a refused edit is copied once, not every pass; a take just recorded here survives a bandmate deleting its track; the together clock no longer drifts in long sessions; a guest's project list arrives before the folder. Tailscale tokens: an older token is checked before use; Forget reaches every script; a slow Syncthing no longer hides the token; Guest makes a plain invitation when the studio's network has no token. Clearer setup wording in the installers, invitation and Health.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Full review fixes: deleting your copy of a song no longer deletes its inbox for everyone; a guest let back in as a member is really back, and a first guest gets the invitation's time; Solo or Produce off no longer cuts off someone listening; a finished print nobody collects stops slowing the tab; preload finishes big catch-ups; Mac/Linux installers use the release, not main. New: Settings > You offers ReaPersona for people coming from another DAW, and the installers list its newest DAWs (Pro Tools Intro, GarageBand, Nuendo). ReaPersona's shortcuts install without Python too. A cross-computer test in tests/cross.

version.author: James
version.changelog: Bring into compares versions, not clocks, so a bandmate's change in the main room is never overwritten by a slow clock; a print plays on an item with an empty take; Prepare names its backup after its own project; a new host signs in to Tailscale once; a guest invitation run again says it's already in. Old unused restore code removed. Cross-computer test passed on Windows desktop, Windows laptop and Mac.

version.author: James
version.changelog: The toolbar button always opens the panel full, and the box or strip opens it first time; the panel only hides when you click a REAPER window it covers (not other apps, dialogs or another monitor), with a Home switch to turn hiding off. Invitations ask whether the person has StudioSync. Render current mix and stems open REAPER's Render window set up as 24-bit WAV to check first. Likes work on parts in lanes. A Mic button for Talk. Colours: a studio look that colours new projects, a clearer card, and try-it-here-first. Plus fixes from a full review: Open and Publish never save over an existing project file, a malformed event can't stop receiving, and more.

Take control and Always follow the driver are under Who can edit. Plug-in lists leave out people who were removed or left. Settings has a Look tab with your own Custom theme, and colour pickers have a colour wheel.

version.author: James

Time-sync puts back the bars-behind setting when it's switched off, and sits below Real time mode's controls.

Prints: a failed print shows in the alert bar with Try again; prints rendered here go in only once whole; long prints aren't retried in a loop. Security: code a bandmate changes in a shared-folder install is checked before it runs; studio settings can't be slipped in through an admin's save.
